activeQuestion.prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [145].
activeQuestion.promptZh: 請選出最適合填入空格 [145] 的字詞或句子。

options.text: Please take your wallet and other personal items home before the move.
options.zh: 請在搬遷前把錢包及其他個人物品帶回家。
options.whyZh: 承接個人貴重物品由物主自行攜帶的規定。

options.text: Customer service will stop operating permanently after April 12.
options.zh: 客服將在四月十二日後永久停止營運。
options.whyZh: 後文說明隔天恢復電話服務，並非永久停業。

options.text: The movers will sell any equipment that has already been packed.
options.zh: 搬運人員會出售所有已裝箱設備。
options.whyZh: 搬家公司負責搬運，全文沒有出售設備的安排。

options.text: Leave all cash inside an unlabelled box in the corridor.
options.zh: 把所有現金放進走廊上未標示的箱子。
options.whyZh: 與自行保管貴重物品及箱子須標示的規定矛盾。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 承接個人貴重物品由物主自行攜帶的規定。

group.title: Office relocation notice
group.passage:
Dear colleagues,

Our customer service team will move to the third floor on April 12. Please label each box with your name and desk number so that the movers can place it [143] ____.

Personal valuables should be carried by their owners. The moving company is responsible only [144] ____ packed office equipment and files. [145] ____

On moving day, incoming calls will be handled by our regional office. Normal telephone service at this site will [146] ____ at 9 a.m. the following morning. Thank you for your cooperation.
